---
applyTo: "src/main/resources/db/**/*.sql"
description: Flyway migration rules for TripWise AI (PostgreSQL 16 + temporary H2 mirror).
---
- **Two locations, same versions:** `db/migration/` (PostgreSQL, source of truth) and `db/h2/` (H2 mirror for profile `h2`). Every new `V{n}__name.sql` must exist in both with identical version + name. H2 translation: `BIGSERIAL` -> `BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY`, `TIMESTAMPTZ` -> `TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE`, `NOW()` -> `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`, `JSONB` -> `JSON` (default `JSON '{}'`), `updated_at` trigger -> `ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`; no PL/pgSQL.
- Never modify an existing `V*` script once applied; add `V{next}__snake_case_description.sql` (double underscore). Check the highest existing version first.
- PostgreSQL 16 syntax. Types: `BIGSERIAL`/`BIGINT` ids, `VARCHAR(n)`, `TEXT`, `NUMERIC(12,2)` money, `DATE`, `TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()`, `JSONB`.
- Name constraints explicitly: `pk_`, `fk_<table>_<ref>`, `uk_<table>_<cols>`, `ck_<table>_<rule>`, `idx_<table>_<cols>`.
- Index every new FK column and every column used in ownership/filter queries.
- New tables with `updated_at` get the trigger: `CREATE TRIGGER trg_<table>_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON <table> FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();` (function defined in V1).
- Adding `NOT NULL` to an existing table: add nullable -> backfill -> set `NOT NULL`, or provide a `DEFAULT`.
- Destructive changes (drop/rename column/table) need explicit approval; prefer expand-then-contract.
- After adding a migration, update the matching JPA entity so `ddl-auto: validate` passes.
